verdict.rationale: Motion documents its own Zapier integration and a booking embed, so a route from bookings into an automation stack exists. Nothing states that booking events are exposed as Zapier triggers, and there is no Salesforce or HubSpot integration. The REST API covers projects and tasks, not bookings. Missing for 10: native Salesforce and HubSpot CRM sync, documented booking-event triggers in Zapier, booking webhooks or API endpoints, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a sales lead, bookings flow into my CRM and automation stack (Salesforce, HubSpot, Zapier) without manual copying

citations.quote: Connect with thousands of the most popular apps using Zapier.
embed Motion's AI Calendar on your website so prospects can book your ideal time slots instantly.
